entities.summary: Sir Michael David Kadoorie is a Hong Kong billionaire businessman, and the chairman and 18% owner of CLP Group, Hong Kong's largest electricity producer. He also owns 47% of Hongkong and Shanghai Hotels. He is a member of the Kadoorie family. Michael Kadoorie was a performers & entertainers from British Hong Kong (b. 1941-07-19, British Hong Kong). A moderately significant entity in the historical record. Relevant to economic history and geopolitics.
